entities.name: Dundoolin
entities.description: The second largest kithkin clachan in Lorwyn, known for its sages and the Eightyfold Trail.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: The only kithkin clachan larger than Dundoolin.

entities.name: Eightyfold Trail
entities.description: An illustrated manuscript of Lorwyn's greater elementals kept by Dundoolin's sages.

entities.name: Library of Dundoolin
entities.description: A collapsed fort at the center of Dundoolin holding buried document caches.

entities.name: Ern Barhen
entities.description: Chief Excavator leading efforts to uncover the fort's chambers.

entities.name: Daranna Gwal
entities.description: Honored cenn of Dundoolin when the Belltower crumbled; named Hyal her heir and died.

entities.name: Hyal Lwellen
entities.description: Daranna's heir and Dundoolin's most famous cenn.

entities.name: Belltower
entities.description: Dundoolin's tower, destroyed by boggarts and later rebuilt.

entities.name: Dundoolin Raiders
entities.description: A militia used to invade boggart warrens, disbanded by Hyal.

entities.name: Paperfin merrows
entities.description: Merrows with whom Hyal set up trade holidays.

entities.name: Book of Kith and Kin
entities.description: Record telling of Daranna and Hyal.

events.summary: Injured Daranna is unable to stop delirious boggarts from destroying the Belltower, though she slays the warren's Auntie.
events.quote: Although she slew the warren's Auntie, she lost pride in her leadership

events.summary: Daranna names Hyal Lwellen her heir, wills him her sword, and dies.
events.quote: she named Hyal Lwellen her heir, willed him her precious sword, and died soon after

events.summary: As cenn, Hyal rebuilds the Belltower, sets up trade holidays with the Paperfin merrows, founds the first elemental school and disbands the Dundoolin Raiders.
events.quote: Hyal's most famous act was to disband the Dundoolin Raiders
